items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: The man, Percy -- ... He said, "I like you __. I like you."

ctx.x: like the train will be coming in the station. He's supposed to stick his head out and I'm supposed to stick my head out, too. But me, I said, oh, listen, this is my chance to get myself straight. They said, let's go. Here it comes around, boy. I stuck my head out, first. I stuck my head out (inaudible). So they say, cut it again.

The next time he stuck his head out, I stuck my shoulder behind him. He stuck his head out. The man, Percy -- (inaudible) you know, if I'd have stuck my head out there three times I don't think we'd ever make the scene. He said, "I like you __. I like you."
